False D Examples of the Augmented Data Example on StrategyQA Original Question (Q): Could the members of The Police perform lawful arrests? Forward Reasoning (R f ): Here is the step-by-step reasoning

monogr.title: Police were a rock band:** Their members were musicians
Law enforcement officers have specific powers:** These powers are granted by the government and include the ability to make arrests
Being in a band called "The Police" does not grant legal authority:** Band names are artistic choices and have no bearing on legal powers

the members of The Police could not perform lawful arrests.** The answer is **no** Backward Question (Q b ): If the members of The Police could not perform lawful arrests, then The Police are likely (A) musicians (B) police officers. Backward Reasoning (R b ): Here is the reasoning: 1. The question implies there are two possible meanings for "The Police
One meaning refers to a group that can make lawful arrests. This is the definition of police officers
The other meaning refers to a group that does not have the authority to make lawful arrests
Since the question states this group cannot make lawful arrests, they cannot be police officers
The Police" in this context likely refers to a group known for something other than law enforcement, making them likely musicians
